description: Alumbrado público is a dataset listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by Intendencia de Rocha. Shapefile que contiene los focos del alumbrado público y cableado existente para todos las localidades urbanas del departamento de Rocha. El conjunto de datos es actualizado y revisado permanentemente por que que pueden existir modificaciones en forma diaria. Coverage: Intendencia de Rocha. The portal files it under the publisher Intendencia de Rocha. Its tags are Alumbrado. It offers 4 resource(s) in SHP, XML. The portal shows 2025-05-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
